title: Media library

story.need: upload and reuse validated images in structured content
story.outcome: site imagery is governed, accessible, and stable across deployments

scope: Use media assets in governed image blocks
dataRequirements: Assets retain stable identifiers and binary content
Metadata includes format, dimensions, size, checksum, alt text, actor, and timestamp
permissions: Anonymous visitors may read referenced media
Only authenticated editors may upload or change metadata

acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated editor and a valid supported image
then: actual image bytes and size are validated
the asset appears in the searchable library

acceptanceCriteria.when: the editor selects a media asset and saves
then: the stable asset identifier is stored
preview and public rendering use the media endpoint
